args: file="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; case "$file" in *.py) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/backend" && uv run ruff check --fix "$file" 2>/dev/null; uv run ruff format "$file" 2>/dev/null ;; *.ts|*.tsx|*.css|*.json) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/frontend" && npx prettier --write "$file" 2>/dev/null && npx eslint --fix "$file" 2>/dev/null ;; esac; true

hooks.command: echo '警告：绕过 hook 的提交/强制推送，请确认操作' >&2
